name: readermode
description: Reader mode toggle that hides sidebars and non-essential UI. Toggles class 'mdf-reader-mode' on <body>. Sub-themes define what gets hidden via CSS. Persistent via localStorage.

params.description: Enable reader mode capability (shows toggle button and loads JS)
params.effect: Loads readermode.js and shows the reader mode toggle button

css.note: No standalone CSS. Sub-theme defines what to hide in main.css: .mdf-reader-mode .sidebar { display: none; }

js.note: Toggles body.mdf-reader-mode class and persists to localStorage 'mdf-reader-mode'. Never modify.

css_in_main.note: Sub-theme defines which elements to hide in reader mode by targeting .mdf-reader-mode in main.css

partials.note: Load readermode.js conditionally: {{ if .Site.Params.readerMode }}<script defer src='caps/readermode/readermode.js'>{{ end }}
